presence_rationale: Dedicated 'Supporting financial wellbeing', 'MoneyMinded', 'MoneyBusiness' and 'Banking the unbanked' sections. Topic comprehensively addressed.
specificity_rationale: Multiple named programmes (MoneyMinded AU/NZ, MoneyBusiness for Indigenous communities, ANZ Plus, Saver Plus, banking-the-unbanked Fiji with UNDP, Comcol NZ partnership). Indigenous business commercial proposition with Indigenous Business Australia. ANZ Roy Morgan Financial Wellbeing Indicator framework explained. >20 years of programme history.
quantification_rationale: MoneyBusiness participation reported: 90,400 cumulative since 2005, 4,702 in 2023. Indigenous business spend: $11.7M in 2023 ($24.4M cumulative since RAP). 280 employees trained in cultural capability. Eight MoneyBusiness coach training sessions. Roy Morgan FWBI tracking shows 19% of Australians 'struggling' (+3 ppt YoY). FN-CB-240a.4 (literacy participants) covered. SASB 240a.1/.2/.3 (small-business loan amounts, no-cost accounts) not disclosed.
